//: Capability manifest for select/1 (the .pa-select control) — keen-pure-admin. select/1 renders <select name id class={select_classes} {@rest}> with a prompt option + options_for_select(@options, @value) inside. Size + state(→validation) + themeColor(→color) are the class axes. disabled/required/multiple ride in :global :rest with STRING keys (maybe_put drops nil/false). color is nativeType string. The option children (`options` list + `prompt`) are OUT OF SCOPE (API-divergent from svelte's children snippet) — not mapped, so options default [] and every scenario renders the empty select.
